cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Let Them Think They Won
cards.instruction: Protect someone’s confidence by hiding how much you softened the challenge, changed the terms, or withheld an advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You beat me at chess. Take a photograph of the board.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why didn't you use your queen?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I wanted to explore the rest of my team.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you go easy on me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You found the finishing move. Let the photograph remember that.
